page.overview:
What is Battle of the Celestial Wake?

The battle of the Celestial Wake was a difficult battle that occurred during the Clone Wars. The clone commando sergeant Sarge participated in this battle. He would later complain about surviving it only to end up doing a ridiculous mission on Garqi. The clone trooper sergeant O'Niner also participated in this battle and survived it.
